chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Muhammad ibn Sama'ah, from Al-Mīthamī, from Abān, from Ismā'īl ibn al-Fadl al-Hāshimī, from Abū 'Abdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم used to perform the maghrib prayer when the sun set, until its edge disappeared.

key_terms.الْمَغْرِبَ: the maghrib prayer, the sunset prayer
key_terms.حَاجِبُهَا: its edge or remaining visible rim
key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم

ai.seo_question: When did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم perform the maghrib prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith reports the practice of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم regarding the time of maghrib prayer. It indicates that maghrib was performed at sunset, marked by the disappearance of the visible edge of the sun.
